verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack mentions Xero's tracking categories (class/location/tag dimensions) or custom report building filtered/grouped by these dimensions; evidence covers dashboards, KPIs, multi-currency, invoicing, and MCP/API tooling but not custom reporting by tracking categories.
